title.narrative: Transforming Youth Skills in South Africa

description.narrative: This project aims to demonstrate an education model that prepares young people for careers beyond coal mining as the country transitions to a low carbon-intensive energy system. In the current context the number of available jobs is insufficient to absorb the number of youth looking for work. This project will prepare young people to create jobs for themselves, as successful entrepreneurs.

actual.value: 336 learners (64% female) participated in the School Enterprise Challenge.

title.narrative: Income generated by School-businesses in 10 secondary schools is set aside to continue/develop the School-business in the following year.

title.narrative: Teachers in 10 schools in Mpumalanga province are trained and equipped with the resources to support learners in experiential entrepreneurship education in a School Business Club and build their understanding of environmental sustainability.

# of teachers trained and equipped with the resources to support learners in a School Business Club and build their understanding of environmental sustainability Means of verification: Pre- and post-training tests, log of resources disseminated.

target.value: 20 (twenty) teachers in 10 schools have the capacity (knowledge, experience and resources) to support learners in experiential entrepreneurship education in a School Business Club and build their understanding of environmental sustainability.

actual.value: 22 teachers (F:15, M:/7) across 10 schools were trained to facilitate the School Enterprise Challenge (SEC)

target.value: 0 (zero) teachers and schools have been capacitated.
